test_protobuf_message_serialization: test protobuf message serialization and deserialization with golden message data for proto2 and proto3
test_repeated_field_operations: test repeated field operations including append, insert, sort, pop, and merge on scalar and composite fields
test_oneof_field_semantics: test oneof field semantics including WhichOneof, HasField, ClearField, and merge behavior
test_map_field_operations: test map field operations including get, set, delete, merge, iteration, and deterministic serialization
test_protobuf_parsing_errors: test protobuf parsing error handling including bad UTF-8, unknown fields, and invalid enum values
